blurb: Huntress Sportfishing offers private fishing charters along the Kona coast, trolling offshore for Pacific blue marlin and other pelagic fish. Trips depart from Honokohau Marina in Kailua-Kona and last six focused hours on the water. The boat is captained by Capt. Jack Leverone, a second generation Kona native and IGFA world record holder.
